result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but the selected category filter does not match the restaurants shown. Horizontal carousel clipping and the card cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll behavior, not defects.

issues.description: The Pizza category chip is shown as selected, but the listings below are not filtered to pizza: Fastest near you shows Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria, and Popular right now shows Tokumaru Ramen Bar.
issues.suggestion: Either clear the Pizza selection when showing mixed results, or filter the carousels and popular list so only pizza restaurants appear while that chip is active.
